meta.title: "from" keyword displaying incorrect completions
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#54843 (fix(54818): "from" keyword displaying incorrect completions), a437de66b6, 2023-06-30; git tag --contains: first in v5.2-rc / v5.2.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.1.6 (2023-06-28) and typescript@5.2.2 (2023-08-24), both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.2 (the latest wrapper release before 5.2.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: Not reproduced after two attempts. Mechanism differs from the screening (wrong completion item offered): at both positions the pre-fix server (5.1.6) answers an EMPTY completion list and the post-fix server offers only the 'from' keyword, so the server-side defect is a missing 'from' keyword completion; the fromBar of the report is most likely the editor's own word-based suggestion shown when the server returns nothing. A missing expected item is not expressible with the edit probes (missing: absent treats 'not offered' as fixed). Attempt 1: the issue's cursor after 'fro'; attempt 2: the regression test's cursor after 'import Foo '.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no jsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project for the JS file.

files.note: the cursor marker '|' after 'fro' removed (it is not part of the code); everything else verbatim

repro.steps: Typing the import statement of the issue ('import Foo ' then 'fro'): attempt 2 requests completions where the fix's regression test (importStatementCompletions4.ts, marker after 'import Foo ') puts the cursor, i.e. with 'fro' not typed yet: delete 'fro' and complete at line 1, character 11. Reported: identifiers containing 'from' such as fromBar are offered where only the 'from' keyword belongs. Probe: accept the offered fromBar item; the edited text must not have a parse error the original did not have. No such item offered counts as absent.

attempts.summary: Completion at the issue's cursor, right after 'import Foo fro' (0, 14), accepting fromBar. Pre-fix 5.1.6 answered an empty list (items: [], isIncomplete: false) in 3/3 runs, post-fix 5.2.2 only 'from'. The server never offered fromBar at that position; the fromBar in the report's screenshot plausibly came from the editor's word-based suggestions shown when the server returns nothing.
